messages:
deploybot: Deploy request — hotfix for embed-service (image: emb-fix-2026-03-23). Canary 1/1 failed with 503s. Impacting embeddings ingestion in EU1. Requesting expedited approval to roll full prod. Details: https://dash.redwood.internal/embeds/alerts/7321

mika: ugh. how bad is the drop? percentage of requests failing? any downstream backlog?

deploybot: error-rate from 0.7% -> 38% over last 9m. Median latency unaffected. Queue depth increased ~3x for secondary consumers. No data loss.

ops-alex: looked at the patch (PR #5238). It's a trivial null-check fix in the tokenizer pipeline that fixes a race. Ran smoke on staging eu1 replica — no 503s. My recommendation: canary to 10% -> monitor 5m -> 50% -> 5m -> 100%. But expedited path allowed with 2 ops approvals.

sara: I'm +1 for expedited. The customer incident page is filling up, we should reduce blast radius quickly. :thumbsup:

devon: Oncall: pinging oncall-bot to confirm readiness and rollback runway.

oncall-bot: devon is oncall for embeddings (rot: devon-east). Pager window clear for next 30m. Rollback window open; if 503s > 5% sustained for 3m at any rollout stage, auto-stop.

devon: I confirm. I can monitor and trigger rollback. +1 from oncall.

mika: two approvals noted. release notes? we need short blurb and a pinned version.

releasebot: Preparing release notes draft: "embed-service: fix race causing occasional 503s under high concurrency. Backported to v2.11.3."
Please confirm release note and pin image tag emb-fix-2026-03-23 -> v2.11.3.

ops-alex: release note ok. pin tag confirmed.

mika: ok — final check: have we set rollback criteria? (explicit command + who runs it)

devon: Rollback criteria: if 503s > 5% for 3m OR successful embeddings drop below baseline by 10% for 5m. Rollback action: run `releasebot rollback embed-service v2.11.2` and call out on #incidents. I will execute if triggered.

ops-alex: approved expedited. documenting manual rollback command here for fast access:
```
# rollback if needed
releasebot rollback embed-service v2.11.2 --region eu1
```

deploybot: Received approvals: ops-alex, sara, devon (oncall). Executing expedited rollout per request. Will skip staged canary and start 30% -> 100% with 3m checks. Executing now.

deploybot: COMMAND: `deploy --service embed-service --image emb-fix-2026-03-23 --strategy expedited --targets eu1:30,eu1:100 --wait 180s`

releasebot: Rollout started by deploybot. Release notes pinned to release-logs/2026-03-23-embfix. Version v2.11.3-embfix pinned.

mika: monitoring dashboards... seeing initial drop in 503s, good sign.

ops-alex: holding until 100% completes. If anything weird, I'll hit rollback.

deploybot: Rollout at 30% -> success. Waiting 180s check window.

deploybot: Rollout at 100% -> success. No rollback triggered.

devon: Observability green. 503s back to 0.9% baseline. Marking incident for closure and adding notes to release doc.

sara: thanks team. will update CS and include a short timeline in the customer update. :heart:

releasebot: Closing the rollout ticket. Follow-up: postmortem not required as fix was trivial and no customer-facing data loss, but add short RCA notes to relnotes.
